name: Isomalt
siboNotes: As a polyol sweetener, isomalt is poorly absorbed and can trigger SIBO symptoms even in very small amounts. Should be completely avoided during SIBO treatment phases.
preparationTips: Check ingredient labels carefully as isomalt appears in sugar-free products
Even small amounts in processed foods can trigger symptoms
Found commonly in sugar-free candies, chocolates, and baked goods
May be listed as E953 on European product labels
alternatives: Small amounts of maple syrup (1 tbsp)
pairsWellWith: Use alternatives with low-FODMAP baking flours
Pair with cinnamon for sweetness enhancement
Use with coconut oil in baking
Blend with cocoa powder for chocolate recipes
nutritionalHighlights: Provides sweetness with fewer calories than sugar
Does not affect blood glucose significantly
